title: iu8 risk multiplier 4.0 -> 1.0: canonical twelve-case prefill +1.39% to +4.07%, decode +0.86% to +1.73%
verdict: KEEP. Faster at every shape on both the weighted mean and the median, on the canonical protocol, with clean provenance on both arms.
quant: mixed GGUF: Q4_K gate/up experts, Q5_1 down experts, Q5_K 2 tensors, Q8_0 5 tensors

host.note: not the gfx1100/W7900 default hardware; absolute rates are not comparable to W7900 rows

protocol: scripts/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_bench.py hipengine --execution-profile production, full twelve-case fixture (benchmarks/fixtures/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_p512_p1024_p4096.json), 4 cases per shape, 3 measured repetitions, 1 warmup, warm PLE cache
why_a_worktree: The canonical harness reads the production profile, and the binder writes HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_Q4_IU8_RISK_MULT unconditionally, so a shell assignment cannot change the arm. The baseline was therefore run from a git worktree at the commit before the promotion, where the binding is still 4.0. Both arms are then committed states with tracked_clean provenance, and the only functional difference between the two commits is the multiplier binding plus its worklog entry.
mechanism: Tightening the Kahan risk bound from 4.0 to 1.0 cuts the repair queue 3.403x (70,167,220 -> 20,621,412 slots over 1504 calls, rate 0.80574% -> 0.23886%, zero over-capacity calls) and the repair kernel's own traced time falls 4808.346 -> 3386.063 ms on code-p4096.

correctness.numerical_gate: passed - mean KL 3.039e-4 against a 1e-3 bar, p99 4.271e-3 against 2e-2, max 7.771e-3 against 5e-2, top-1 0.99556, scope_failures null, determinism and isolation clean (3.3-6.4x aggregate margin, including 274x improvement on the prefill_last scope that rejected the repair-free sibling)
correctness.task_gate: requires_review - 15/18 strict-exact, candidate repeat-deterministic with no repeat mismatches, and three cosmetic divergences (an extra 'Deque,' in an import list; two reworded, semantically equivalent clauses). Per AGENTS.md cross-width generated-ID equality is diagnostic rather than binding; the calibrated production envelope is the binding gate and it passes.

residual.derivation: Fitting time = F + k*queue over the two kernel-trace arms gives k = 2.871e-5 ms/slot and F = 2794.1 ms, i.e. 58.1% of the repair at multiplier 4.0 is independent of the queue. This survives the promotion unchanged and is a separate launch-geometry target.
residual.note: Fitted from two points, so F and k describe the observed pair and are not a validated model of the pass.

rollback: Set HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_Q4_IU8_RISK_MULT back to "4.0" in hipengine/generation/qwen4_exp_profiles.py. The strict fallback is registered and untouched.
limits: One host (gfx1151 APU), one model, one quant, one execution profile, one fixture.
Absolute rates are profiler-free but single-host; they are not comparable to W7900 rows.
The 1024-shape gain (+4.07%) is the largest; the others are +1.39% and +1.70%. A single-shape claim would overstate or understate the result.
The task gate is requires_review rather than passed; the review is recorded above and its outcome is a judgement call, stated rather than hidden.
